scientific_integrity: Exact proof from group matrix trace, cat-map congruences and strict derivative bounds; finite independent computations used only as consistency checks; previous special-slice result explicitly excluded from novelty claim.
scientific_limitations: No fold classification for driving periods three or greater, no global attractor–repeller collision result, and no invariant-measure claim. Uniqueness rests on rigorous analytic derivative bounds. An equivalent historical computation cannot be absolutely ruled out.
scientific_scope: For the Chigarev–Kazakov–Pikovsky cat-driven torus skew map at \(\varepsilon=2/5\) and \(0<\mu\le1/10\), with phase \(-\pi/2\le\alpha\le\pi/2\), the first positive nonidentity folds of the fixed-base and two primitive base-period-two fibers have exactly two phase crossings that reorder the earliest of the three.
title: Three-way short-period fold ordering in an Anosov-driven Möbius map
